snippet.title: Early Access Launch Trailer | Revenge of the Savage Planet | PAX East
snippet.description:
Strap in for your next mission to deep space with Revenge of the Savage Planet, now available with Early Access through the Cosmic Hoarder Edition!  Grab a friend and blast-off with exclusive limited-time launch perks including the Cinco de Mayo Trash panda Suit and DAVE THE DIVER.

Revenge of the Savage Planet is a joyous, upbeat, action adventure sci-fi satire where you and a friend explore a wacky and wonderful alien world. Jump, shoot and collect your way through four vibrant planets, collecting new gear and upgrades, while uncovering the various secrets hidden.  Don’t miss out, secure your spot in space! Wishlist, pre-order or purchase Revenge of the Savage Planet, now available.  

Xbox: Join us for the colonization of space Day One with Xbox Game Pass.  Visit the Xbox Store to view the launch bonus programs and Cosmic Hoarder Edition upgrade option. 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/revenge-of-the-savage-planet/9pftv8dknchx 

Steam: Purchase within the first month of launch and receive a bonus copy of Journey to the Savage Planet.  Additionally, purchase the first week on Steam and you’ll also receive a 10% discount.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/ 

Playstation: DAVE THE DIVER and the Cinco de Mayo Trash Panda Suit are available. 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009791/

Check out the additional ways to book a trip to space - https://www.savageplanet.games/en-US/play 

Follow @SavagePlanetHub on social for more information and content.
